name: gcp-api
description: The Google REST root, the RS256 JWT bearer grant and the error shape — so the modules that call Google do not each hand-roll the same sixty lines
instructions: The library every Google module imports as `../gcp-api`. It speaks raw REST and signs its own bearer assertion rather than pulling in `googleapis` or shelling out to `gcloud`: the grant is twenty lines, and a CI runner has neither the SDK nor the binary. Two consumers had already written it twice, identically.
